subject: Kill the kid in Wendel
text: The achievement for killing the kid in Wendel requires doing it after Glaive's attack, and it cannot be done before.

evidence.quote: For "Blood on your hands?", you have to kill the kid in Wendel (just after Glaive's attack). Not doable before.

subject: Beyond the Oasis
text: The Beyond the Oasis achievement has no linked memory state, so it may have issues and needs savestates to work on it.

evidence.quote: "beyond the oasis" has no memory state linked to it so it may have some issues but need savestates in order to work on it.

subject: Discarding items
text: Items can be destroyed with the bin at the bottom of the inventories.

evidence.quote: destroy item with the bin at the bottom of the inventories

subject: It taste like (silver) chicken
text: Near the time of the silver chicken achievement, XP and cash can be boosted very quickly.

evidence.quote: By the time you unlock the 'It taste like (silver) chicken' achievement in the game, you'll be close to a point where you can boost XP and cash very quickly.

subject: The Way of the Warrior, Wizard, Tank and Monk
text: The four Way of achievements can be missed if the same attribute is always chosen when leveling up.

evidence.quote: The Way of the Warrior, The Way of the Wizard, The Way of the Tank and The Way of the Monk are technically missable if you always choose the same attribute while leveling up.

subject: Save before the sunk tower
text: Making a second save just before the sunk tower in the desert is advised to avoid missing achievements on a first playthrough.

evidence.quote: if you don't want to miss any achievements on your first playthrough, make a second save just before the sunk tower in the desert.

subject: Werewolf respawn farming
text: Four werewolves on a screen reached after buying oil respawn when re-entering, allowing fast leveling.

evidence.quote: There are also 4 werewolves on this screen. If you kill them and leave/enter to the location, the werewolves will respawn.

subject: Keys
text: Players should buy plenty of keys.

evidence.quote: Don't forget to buy lots of keys

subject: Snowman puzzle
text: If your companion breaks the snowman you pushed for a puzzle, stay calm.

evidence.quote: keep calm when your companion breaks the snowman you just pushed to solve the puzzle

subject: Kill innocent boy and samurai armour and helm
text: The innocent boy kill and samurai armour and helm achievements are missable, and one commenter needed a save file to get them.

evidence.quote: I had to use a save file to get the killing innocent boy and samurai armour and helm achievments cuz they are fkin missable.

subject: Defeat Iflyte
text: A player who killed Iflyte and then went back for the Zeus Axe missed the Iflyte achievement.

evidence.quote: i'm literally only missing the iflyte one because i killed the boss but then went back for Zeus Axe.

subject: To Infinity and Beyond
text: The To Infinity and Beyond achievement took one commenter three attempts to pop.

evidence.quote: Only one I really had an issue with was To Infinity and Beyond, which I needed to attempt thrice before I finally got the achievement to pop.

subject: Robots Can't Jump
text: The Robots Can't Jump achievement triggers before its cutscene, which one commenter found spoils the moment.

evidence.quote: my only complaint is that "Robots Can't Jump" triggering before its respective cutscene kinda spoils the moment.

subject: Boss fights
text: The game lets you save before any boss for retries.

evidence.quote: the only good thing is that you can save before any boss for retries.

subject: Stat points
text: Stat points should be spread evenly, since reaching 50 later is hard if one stat is over-invested.

evidence.quote: if you dont "waste stats" in a balanced manner, good luck getting the 50 stat points later down the line.

subject: Phantom hits
text: A commenter noticed many phantom hits with certain weapons.

evidence.quote: I did notice a lot of phantom hits especially with certain weapons.
